Cc: Acme AI Team <ai@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff recap + usage numbers

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the call today — appreciated the clear breakdown of pricing and the options for dedicated vs hosted. Quick recap from our side: we kicked off the generative search pilot yesterday and saw immediate traffic from our internal beta (approx 12 internal users, ramping to ~150 next week). Attached is a short CSV with tokens/day and call volume from our first 24h.

Two asks before we move into the wider pilot next week:
- Can Redwood approve a short credits extension? Our burn-rate looks higher than we forecasted in the discovery due to longer conversations (~1.2k tokens avg/request).
- Can you confirm target unit economics — we want to model cost at scale. Specifically: what should we assume for $/1M tokens for the recommended model variant?

If helpful, I can schedule a quick sync early next week to walk through the CSV.

Thanks,
Jenna
Jenna Park
Senior PM, Search
Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff recap + usage numbers

Hi Jenna — great to meet on the call and thanks for sending the usage CSV. Quick notes after I reviewed the numbers:

- Observed avg tokens/request ~1200 matches what you saw. With that payload, your burn-rate projects to ~36M tokens/week if you hit 150 active users making ~20 requests/day each.
- For cost modeling on the hosted plan, a reasonable target to assume is $650 / 1M tokens for the recommended LlamaX-13B quantized variant (includes network and infra overhead). If you later move to Redwood Dedicated with reserved capacity, you can push that down by ~20-30% depending on commit size and batching.

Regarding credits: we can approve a one-time 100k free tokens extension to cover the ramp and give us a week to reassess actual burn. If you need more, say 250k, we'll need a short business note (expected users, target duration) so I can get an additional sign-off from Rishi.

Next steps I recommend:
1) We attach the 100k credit now so you don't hit throttles during ramp.
2) You share an updated 72-hour usage snapshot on Thursday so we can re-evaluate weeks 2-3.
3) If the projections still look >200k/week, we'll discuss a temporary pilot top-up (250k) + a short mutual action plan for conversion.

I'll attach a proposed extension SOW/approval stub in a follow-up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-extension-SOW.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Per your ask, I’m attaching a 72-hour snapshot from our telemetry and a short note with projected active users + expected requests/day. Can you confirm when the 100k will be applied? Also, what’s the turnaround for reviewing the 250k request?

Hi Jenna — quick update:

- I’ve applied the 100,000 token credit to your pilot account (should be visible in the Console under Billing > Credits within 15 minutes).
- I also forwarded your 72-hour snapshot and the quick projection note to Rishi for the 250k top-up approval. He flagged two things he wants to validate before we push the larger extension: 1) expected duration (weeks) for the 250k, and 2) a brief mutual action plan that maps success criteria to conversion (e.g., latency <150ms p50, quality score >0.82 on the eval set, and projected M4 ARR if we hit X usage).

If you can drop the MAP and a 2-line expected duration (e.g., 3 weeks) into a reply, I’ll expedite. I’m tentatively marking this as a sales-led pilot and will route the 250k to contracts once Rishi signs off.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming receipt of the 100k credit (visible in Console). Per Rishi’s ask, here’s the short MAP and duration:

MAP (summary):
- Success criteria: latency p50 < 150ms, quality eval score > 0.82 on our 10k prompt set, weekly active users = 1,200 internal beta users (target week 3).
- Expected duration for 250k: 3 weeks (covers week 2-4 ramp).
- Conversion trigger: 30-day discounted reserved commit evaluation if week 4 meets success criteria.

We’ll keep monitoring and will send a mid-week burn snapshot on Thursday. Appreciate the help — if Rishi needs anything else, loop him in.

Best,
Jenna

Acme Corp
